python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'laspy/laswriter.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('laspy.laswriter')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
import io
import numpy as np
import laspy
header=laspy.LasHeader(point_format=3)
header.scales=np.array([1.,1.,1.])
header.offsets=np.array([10.,10.,10.])
points=laspy.ScaleAwarePointRecord.zeros(2,point_format=header.point_format,scales=[.1,.5,1.],offsets=[0.,0.,0.])
points.x=[10.,12.]
points.y=[20.,22.]
points.z=[30.,32.]
old=(points.scales.copy(),points.offsets.copy(),points.X.copy(),points.Y.copy(),points.Z.copy())
with io.BytesIO() as stream:
 with laspy.LasWriter(stream,header,closefd=False) as writer:
  writer.write_points(points)
 stream.seek(0)
 result=laspy.read(stream)
 print("written_xyz",result.xyz.tolist())
 assert np.array_equal(result.xyz,[[10.,20.,30.],[12.,22.,32.]])
for before,after in zip(old,(points.scales,points.offsets,points.X,points.Y,points.Z)):
 assert np.array_equal(before,after)
print("input_scaling_and_packed_coordinates_preserved",True)

from typing import BinaryIO, Iterable, Optional, Union

import numpy as np

restore_scaling = isinstance(points, ScaleAwarePointRecord) and (
            np.any(points.scales != self.header.scales)
            or np.any(points.offsets != self.header.offsets)
        )
        if restore_scaling:
            original_scales, original_offsets = points.scales, points.offsets
            original_coordinates = points.X.copy(), points.Y.copy(), points.Z.copy()
            points.change_scaling(scales=self.header.scales, offsets=self.header.offsets)
        try:
            self.header.grow(points)
            self.point_writer.write_points(points)
        finally:
            if restore_scaling:
                points.scales, points.offsets = original_scales, original_offsets
                points.X, points.Y, points.Z = original_coordinates
